scope: Skill entry dependency smoke only. Original PREPARE/isolated QA transport, true character entry and skill TAB, one real scroll; no learn/equip/remove/auto changes or detail matrix. Startup/normalization save side effects retained. Exact restore baseline is immediately before PREPARE actor seed, after startup/skill module initialization; earlier startup private caches not restored. Integrated dev formal24px timer/46px prompt and existing readable skill picker only; synthetic no-reward battle entry, timers stopped for static inspection, no attack/skill/potion/settlement. Full/insufficient SP display fixture only; no natural combat/hardware claim.
